narration:
The same money, a different life.
In month {fork_month}, after {identical_months} months that matched, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}.
In month {substitution_month}, {withdrawn_choice} was not available on this path, so the ghost took {substitute_choice}.
In month {layoff_month}, at the layoff, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}.
The ghost's Freedom ended {freedom_gap}, and more of its pay was committed before each month began.
The ghost's Safety ended {safety_gap}, and it could last longer with no pay.
By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
